name: Irsee (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Irsee (a white lion on red).
history: The municipality flies a white-red-white striped flag charged with the arms shifted upward; the arms were granted by King Ludwig I on 15 July 1837.

features.role: Irsee arms — white lion on red
